limitations: Real adapter constructors, REST request builders, CandleProcessor gap jobs/replay and CandleStore run against captured native provider OHLCV. HTTP, clock and timers are controlled. Indicators and strategy intake are observation seams.
Explicit truncation, unavailable, malformed, retention, cursor and sparse scenarios alter the transport response only. They are controlled fault scenarios, not claims of live exchange events.
Known boundaries are seeded through processNewCandle; startBackfill is invoked directly for reproducible stock-session and higher-frame coverage. No production orders or PM2 changes.
